Wiom Net SOPs

Step-by-step process guides for support agents

1. Flow Diagram

2. Step-by-Step (Plain Language)

Normal step Decision point (branch) Success / internet connected
A

Customer connects to WiomNet

On the customer's phone/laptop wiom net list, they tap the network named "wiom net" (secondary SSID) and connect.

↓
B

Phone shows a message

One of these 3 things happens on the customer's screen:

1️⃣ "Connected, no internet" → Tell customer: open any browser (Chrome) and try to visit any website (e.g. google.com). This will trigger the login page to pop up.
2️⃣ "Connected, tap to sign in to network" → Tell customer: tap that notification directly — it opens the login page.
3️⃣ Login page (captive portal) opens on its own → No action needed, move straight to the next step.
↓
?

Is this the customer's first time on WiomNet?

Yes → go to Step C.  |  No → system already knows their number, skip to "User has active recharge?"

↓
C

First-time user enters mobile number

Customer types their mobile number into the portal. System then checks if this number has an active recharge.

↓
?

Does the user have an active recharge?

Yes → go to Step I (OTP login).  |  No → go to Step D (buy a recharge).

↓
I

OTP login (customer already has a recharge)

OTP page opens, OTP sent to the customer's number. Customer enters the OTP.

❌ Wrong OTP → let them retry, no limit on attempts.
✅ Correct OTP + recharge still active → Internet connects.
↓
✓

Internet Connected 🎉

Customer is online. Case closed.

↓

— OR, if no active recharge —

↓
D

Recharge selection page

Customer sees available WiomNet recharges and picks one.

↓
E

Payment link sent via SMS

System sends a payment link by SMS to the customer's device.

↓
?

Does the customer have mobile data to open the link?

No → go to Step F.  |  Yes → go to Step G.

↓
F

No mobile data — temporary free recharge

Customer is assigned a temporary free recharge. Internet connects, usable up to 3 times a day.

↓
G

Payment page

Customer pays for the recharge on this page.

❌ Payment failed → let them retry, no limit on attempts.
↓
H

Payment successful

Two outcomes depending on whether the customer's device is still on wiom net:

✅ Still connected to wiom net → Internet connects.
⚠️ Not connected to wiom net → Recharge is assigned, but did not connect — customer must reconnect and try via OTP (back to Step I).
↓
✓

Internet Connected 🎉

Customer is online. Case closed.

3. Quick Reference — Situation → What To Do

Situation What the agent should do Say this to the customer
Phone says "Connected, no internet" Guide customer to open a browser and visit any website to trigger the login page. "Please open Chrome and type google.com — the login page should pop up."
Phone says "Tap to sign in to network" Tell customer to tap that notification directly. "You'll see a notification saying 'tap to sign in' — please tap on it."
Captive portal doesn't open at all Ask customer to forget the WiomNet network and reconnect. If still stuck, escalate. "Let's forget the wiom net network on your phone and reconnect fresh."
Wrong OTP entered Let the customer retry — there's no limit on attempts. Confirm the number is correct. "No worries, let's try entering the OTP again."
Payment failed on Step G Let the customer retry payment — unlimited attempts allowed. "That didn't go through, let's try the payment once more."
Payment successful but internet still not working Check if the customer's device is still connected to wiom net. If not, ask them to reconnect and log in again via OTP. "Your recharge is active — please reconnect to wiom net, and the portal will send an OTP for you to log in with."
No mobile data to open payment link Assign the temporary free recharge (usable up to 3 times a day) so the customer has internet while they sort out payment. "I've given you a free temporary connection for now — let's get your recharge sorted."

What the Customer Sees — Screen by Screen

Matches the same A–I steps from the flow diagram, so agents can see exactly what the customer is looking at on their phone.

A

Connect to wiom net

Customer taps the "wiom net" network from their wiom net list. This is what the connect notification looks like.

B

Captive portal welcome page

This purple welcome screen opens automatically (or after tapping the sign-in notification / visiting any website).

C

New user — enter mobile number

First-time users see this screen asking for their phone number.

D

Recharge selection

Customer picks a recharge. Current recharges: 6 hours and 12 hours.

E

Payment link sent via SMS

Left: portal tells customer to check SMS. Right: the SMS with the payment link that arrives.

F

Temporary free recharge

Shown when customer has no mobile data to open the payment link — a 100-second free session is granted.

G

Payment page

Customer completes payment here via UPI app or QR code.

H

After payment

Left: "Hold on" while payment verifies. Right: "Payment successful" confirmation once done.

I

Return OTP

OTP is sent to the customer's number to complete login and connect.

How agents use this: First find out if the customer's WiomNet recharge is currently active (from Step 1 flow / Wiom Hub). Then follow the matching diagram below to know what to ask next. Once you reach an end box, look up that exact situation in the table underneath to get the issue tag to log the case under, and the advice to give the customer.

1. If the Recharge IS Active

2. If the Recharge is NOT Active

3. Refund Conditions

When a refund applies depends on whether the customer's recharge is currently active or not.

If recharge IS active — refund when

1. Device ping has been down for more than 2 hours, OR
2. Wiom Hub shows the customer as "Refund Eligible" (see screenshot below)

If recharge is NOT active — refund when

Customer is visibly very upset and specifically disputes/complains about the recharge amount — refund as resolution.

Wiom Hub → Wiom Net → Plan Extension. When a customer qualifies, the panel shows an orange "Refund Eligible" banner: "This customer's plan is eligible for a refund. Plan extension is disabled while a refund is pending." Extension is blocked automatically while a refund is pending — don't try to extend in this state, process the refund instead.

What this tab is for: Every possible call outcome for WiomNet in one place — the situation, exactly what to ask the customer, which CRM tag to use, what action gets triggered, and anything else the agent should keep in mind.

All Use Cases — Situation, Script, Tag & Trigger

# Situation What to ask the customer CRM Issue Tag Trigger / Action Agent notes
1 wiom net hotspot at the location isn't providing internet at all (device ping down). WiomNet is public wiom net — the customer has no router of their own. “Are you able to see 'wiom net' in your wiom net list at all? Are you at a spot where wiom net is normally available?” No internet on router None — ask customer to retry after some time If recharge turns out to be active once the hotspot is back up, give an extension or refund depending on downtime.
2 wiom net not connecting, but the wiom hotspot at that location is online (device ping active). “Can you see 'wiom net' in your wiom net list? Try moving a little closer to where the wiom net point usually is and check again.” wiom net signal not showing None — ask customer to retry after some time If recharge is active, give an extension for the downtime.
3 Customer is connected to wiom net, but the login/captive portal page won't open. “You're connected to wiom net, right? Please try opening any website like google.com — does a sign-in page pop up?” Captive portal does not open None — ask customer to retry after some time If recharge is active, give an extension for the downtime.
4 Customer selected a recharge but never received the payment SMS link. “Did you select a recharge on the page? Have you received an SMS with a payment link? Please check your messages.” Payment SMS link not received Guide customer to reselect the recharge on the portal — this triggers a fresh SMS link automatically Confirm customer is not opening an old/previous SMS link before guiding them to reselect.
5 No active recharge, no mobile data available, and the free temporary recharge already used up for the day. “Do you currently have mobile data turned on? Have you already used the free temporary connection today?” Free recharge limit exhausted Ask customer to turn on mobile data and retry payment via the SMS link, staying connected to wiom net Not applicable if recharge is already active.
6 Customer received the SMS link, attempted payment, but it failed. “Did the payment go through completely? Any error message shown on screen?” Payment Unsuccessful Ask customer to reconnect to wiom net, select the recharge again, and use a fresh SMS link (mobile data on if possible) Not applicable if recharge is already active.
7 Payment went through successfully, but the customer's internet still isn't working. “Did the payment complete successfully on your end? Are you still connected to wiom net right now?” Payment successful, could not connect Investigate — refund if confirmed true Ask customer to reconnect to wiom net and enter the OTP to complete login.
8 Customer already paid once, but the portal is asking them to pay again. “Have you already made a payment for this recharge? Is it asking you to pay again right now?” Payment successful, asking for payment again Investigate — refund if confirmed true Ask customer to reconnect to wiom net and enter the OTP to complete login.
9 Customer has an active recharge and is connected, but the OTP never arrived. “Is the mobile number showing correct? Have you received any OTP SMS in the last few minutes?” OTP not received None — ask customer to retry after some time Not applicable if recharge is not active.
10 Customer has an active recharge, is connected, but OTP keeps failing or resend limit is hit. “How many times have you tried entering the OTP? Is there any specific error message showing?” OTP not working/OTP limit exhausted None — ask customer to retry after some time Applies whether or not recharge is active — cooldown period needed either way.
11 None of the above — customer has a general question about their WiomNet recharge, pricing, or usage. “What would you like to know about your WiomNet connection or recharge?” General Enquiry None — handle as standard enquiry Use this tag only when no technical issue matches any other case above.
